decision: swept slippage 0 to 5c on the full-history proportional copy

decision: delegated network/CPU/hardware research to a subagent, then corrected its draft
why: parallel work while I profiled; its 99%-DB claim was wrong against my profile, and its colocation advice needed an eligibility caveat

decision: counted SQL per copy and profiled before changing anything
why: pick the real cost: 39 statements, ~45% Postgres wait, ~40% SQLAlchemy CPU; synchronous_commit off gained 2-3%

decision: trimmed 5 statements from the pre-order path and cached the geoblock result for 90 s
why: the geoblock HTTPS call cost 120-430 ms before every live order

decision: did not move SELL-path positions from Data API to CTF balanceOf
why: measured: identical values but Data API 33 ms vs RPC 100 ms p50 from here

decision: measured mempool visibility before building on it
why: only worth it if pending matchOrders arrive early and decode exactly
evidence: backend/scripts/mempool_probe.py; 10 min: 21,553 fills, 85% pending first, p50 836 ms, 18,369/18,371 agree

decision: copy from pending matchOrders on a separate socket; dedupe via the tape's cross-source rule
why: largest remaining lead; separate socket keeps the firehose off the log stream

decision: did not warm the SDK's order metadata cache
why: only reachable through private SDK internals that break on upgrade

decision: deleted 4 dead symbols; added order-book and leader-election tests
why: clob.py was 26% covered and prices every copy; workers.py holds the no-double-trade invariant

decision: warmed new listings and made market metadata stale-while-revalidate
why: ~27% of copies are a first fill in a market and each paid ~182 ms Gamma calls
result: test fails without the warmup; 332 tests

why: check whether sub-1-dollar skipped buys hurt returns
result: +226% to +236%; skips barely matter (no impact model)

decision: reconcile pending copies by receipt; flag reverted or dropped ones
why: mempool copying trades before the tx is mined

decision: set the paper account's max entry price to 0.90 and left the app default at 0.75
why: backtest: 0.90 gives +232% vs +174% at 0.75 for this sharp; one wallet is too little to change the default

decision: did not add a minimum source trade size filter
why: every threshold lowered the return in the sweep

decision: priced pending taker fills from their matched makers instead of the order limit
why: the limit overstated the source's price by 0.3-3c, which skews the entry cap and drift check
evidence: https://github.com/gokulsivaji03-svg/poly/pull/12; captured txs equal exactly; live 4,942/5,063 equal
